lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense matrix of high-luminance circular clusters is organized in a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, extending posteriorly from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting horizontal rows of blobs to create a series of anchor points in a checkerboard-like configuration.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from a high-intensity upper edge to a low-intensity shadow beneath.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a scattered distribution of approximately 10-12 discrete high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily in the central and basal regions of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated, low-luminance features (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
